parent.sha256sums_source: SHA256SUMS on the akh-medu-runs share (hash-verified by the 2026-09-27 migration); weights, config and tokenizer are the same pins as scripts/lilith/runpod/bootstrap.sh

llama_cpp.hip_rocm_known_bad_reason: Verified 2026-09-30 on hephaistos (Zorin 17.3 = Ubuntu 22.04 jammy, ROCm 6.3.4, gfx1100): compiling the pinned commit's mmf template instances fails with 'Illegal instruction detected: Invalid dpp_ctrl value: wavefront shifts are not supported on GFX10+'. llama.cpp's docs state no minimum ROCm version, so the rule is: 6.3.4 and older are known bad, and a newer ROCm has to be proven by a build.
llama_cpp.converter_transformers_reason: llama.cpp's own requirements pin transformers 4.57.6, whose AutoTokenizer raises AttributeError on the parent's tokenizer_config.json (extra_special_tokens is a list, a transformers 5 format; the parent was written by transformers 5.10.0.dev0). Verified 2026-09-29 on the pinned converter: 4.57.6 fails, 5.17.0 exports the vocabulary and chat template.

vulkan_sdk.reason: Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy) has no glslc package and ships Vulkan 1.3.204 headers; the pinned llama.cpp then fails with 'PFN_vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT does not name a type' (VK_EXT_device_fault arrived in header 1.3.246). The LunarG SDK supplies glslc and current headers; the build uses it from the work directory, nothing is installed system-wide. Verified 2026-09-30 on hephaistos.
